shellScript.title: Shell Script Library

help.intro: The Shell Script Library centrally manages reusable operations scripts, runs them on one or multiple servers with one click, and automatically records output and status of every run for unified management and troubleshooting.
help.configDesc: Three configuration methods are supported: 1) Environment variables - injected at runtime as KEY=VALUE and referenced with ${KEY} or ${KEY:-default}; 2) Positional arguments - referenced with $1 $2; 3) Config files - read any config file on the remote server from within the script.
help.runItem1: Select a script and click the "Run" button
help.runItem2: Select one or multiple target servers
help.runItem3: Fill in environment variables, positional arguments and timeout as needed
help.runItem4: Review each server's output, exit code and duration after execution; results are also saved to "Execution History"
help.versionDesc: Every content change creates a new version and keeps old snapshots. Use "Versions" to view history or roll back at any time.
help.compatDesc: Scripts run with bash and are compatible with most Linux distributions (Debian/Ubuntu/CentOS/RHEL etc.). Content is transferred via base64 so quotes and newlines are safe. POSIX-compatible syntax is recommended for maximum compatibility.
